Issue 04:
# 04 — Tag filter + search

Status: needs-triage
Type: AFK

## What to build

Add a search bar and tag filter pills above the gallery. Both filter the already-fetched products array in memory — no extra DB calls. Search matches product name, description, and tags. Tag pills are derived from the union of all tags across all products. Filters compose: both search and active pill must match.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Search bar appears above the gallery grid
- [ ] Tag pills are derived dynamically from all products' `tags` arrays (no hardcoded list)
- [ ] Typing in search bar filters products by name, description, or tag in real time
- [ ] Clicking a tag pill filters to products containing that exact tag
- [ ] Active tag pill is visually distinct from inactive pills
- [ ] Multiple tag pills can be selected simultaneously; product must match all selected tags
- [ ] Search and tag filter compose: product must match both
- [ ] Clearing search and deselecting all pills restores the full product list
- [ ] Tests: all filtering combinations above

## Blocked by

- 03 — Product gallery


---

Issue 06:
# 06 — Checkout form + create-payment-intent Edge Function

Status: needs-triage
Type: AFK

## What to build

Build the checkout form and the `create-payment-intent` Supabase Edge Function. The form collects customer and shipping details. On submit, it calls the Edge Function which validates the cart server-side, writes a pending order to Supabase, and returns a Stripe `clientSecret`. After this slice the full order record exists in the DB before any payment is taken.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `CheckoutForm` collects: full name, email, street address, city, postal code, country
- [ ] All fields are required; form does not submit if any are empty
- [ ] On submit, form calls `create-payment-intent` Edge Function with cart items and customer data
- [ ] Edge Function fetches product prices from DB — never trusts client-provided prices
- [ ] Edge Function returns 400 if any `product_id` is not found in the DB
- [ ] Edge Function returns 400 if any item has `is_available = false`
- [ ] Edge Function writes one `orders` row with `status: order_received` and all customer/shipping fields
- [ ] Edge Function writes one `order_items` row per cart item with `price_at_purchase` from DB
- [ ] Edge Function creates a Stripe PaymentIntent in EUR and returns `clientSecret`
- [ ] Edge Function does NOT create a Stripe PaymentIntent if any validation fails
- [ ] `VITE_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY`, `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` configured in the correct environments
- [ ] Tests: all Edge Function validation and DB-write behaviours

## Blocked by

- 01 — Supabase schema + project config
- 05 — Cart + CartDrawer

plan.sprint_goal: Implement in-memory tag + search filtering on the gallery and build the checkout form with the create-payment-intent Edge Function that validates cart server-side and writes a pending order to Supabase before any charge occurs.

dev1.task: Add a search bar and multi-select tag pill filter above the gallery grid in Gallery.jsx. Derive tag pills from the union of all products' tags arrays. Filter the already-fetched products array in memory on every keystroke or pill click. Both filters must compose (product must match search AND all selected tags). Active pills must be visually distinct. Also write tests covering all filtering combinations described in Issue 04.
dev1.context_needed: Gallery.jsx already imports useProducts hook (src/hooks/useProducts.js) which returns { products, loading, error } where each product has shape { id, name, description, price, image_url, tags: string[], is_available }. ProductCard.jsx accepts product prop and onAddToCart callback. The Gallery.jsx page is the integration point — SearchBar and TagPills should be mounted above the existing grid. Test file should use the same vitest + @testing-library/react setup defined in src/test/setup.js.

dev2.task: Create the create-payment-intent Supabase Edge Function. It receives POST body { items: [{ product_id, quantity }], customer: { name, email, street, city, postal_code, country } }. Steps in order: (1) fetch all referenced products from DB and return 400 if any product_id not found or any is_available = false; (2) calculate total in cents from DB prices only; (3) create Stripe PaymentIntent in EUR using STRIPE_SECRET_KEY from env; (4) insert one orders row with status order_received, all customer/shipping fields, total, and stripe_payment_id = pi.id; (5) insert order_items rows with price_at_purchase from DB; (6) return { clientSecret }. Also write tests covering all validation and DB-write behaviours from Issue 06 acceptance criteria.
dev2.context_needed: Schema: products(id, name, price INTEGER cents, is_available BOOLEAN, tags TEXT[]). orders(id, stripe_payment_id TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT, total INTEGER, customer_name, customer_email, shipping_street, shipping_city, shipping_postal_code, shipping_country, created_at). order_items(id, order_id, product_id, quantity, price_at_purchase INTEGER). RLS: orders INSERT/UPDATE only via service role key — Edge Function must use SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY env var to bypass RLS. Stripe PaymentIntent must be created in eur. Do not trust any price from the client request body. If DB insert fails after PI creation, the dangling PI expires in 24h and never charges — this is acceptable.

plan.shared_types: CartItem: { id: string, name: string, price: number, image_url: string, quantity: number }. CheckoutCustomer: { name: string, email: string, street: string, city: string, postal_code: string, country: string }. CreatePaymentIntentRequest: { items: Array<{ product_id: string, quantity: number }>, customer: CheckoutCustomer }. CreatePaymentIntentResponse: { clientSecret: string }. Product: { id: string, name: string, description: string, price: number, image_url: string, tags: string[], is_available: boolean }. Both devs must agree that price is always integer cents — never a float.
